The '''Wizardman Bureau''' is a sub-location of {{Zone|The Mountaintop}}. It can be entered by completing the {{Zone|Walk of Fame}} and obtaining the {{Item|Celestial Timecharm}}.

== Features ==
The '''Wizardman Bureau''' features a few attractions.

=== Wizardman Trials ===
{{Main|Wizardman#Trials}}
After saying {{Code|Help Wizardman!}} in chat, {{NPCSprite|Wizardman}} offers the [[Wizardman#Trials|Wizardman Trials]].

=== Connections ===
A back door exits back to {{zone|The Mountaintop}} near [[The Breach]]. This can only be used after completing the [[Wizardman#Trials|Wizardman Trials]] and obtaining the {{Item|Wizard Face}}.

{{zone|The Vents}} can also be accessed up a ladder on the left.
